title: Edge Routing
body: Orthogonal edge routing (PRD §12.3: Schematify shall route an edge orthogonally. An edge crosses a group border. An edge never enters a sibling box). Both constraints are one predicate — does a segment enter this box — applied to a list the caller chooses. `frame.ts` builds that list, and deliberately leaves containers out of it: a group's border is crossable, a peer's box is not. This module never decides what an obstacle is.
